releaseNotes: Nokiatis MUC 1.17.0-beta.2 — the look-and-feel pass: the header glow is now a true circular halo instead of a square, every song row shows a visible green Share button (no more hunting behind the three-dot menu), and the download sheet says exactly 'Remove download' when a song is offline. Failed user downloads now retry themselves once after 20 seconds, and the next song in your queue is quietly cached while the current one plays. This is a BETA: it never locks the app and can always be skipped.
